title: SaoutiAgentTimelineEvent
description: Schema for events that feed the Agent Presence Chip and Activity Timeline

id.description: Unique identifier for this execution step

agent.description: The active AI agent assigned to this step

action.description: Lowercase action description (e.g. 'drafting the LinkedIn version')

state.description: Current lifecycle status of the step

durationSeconds.description: Duration in seconds for steps in 'done' state

pauseCountdownSeconds.description: Countdown seconds remaining for steps in 'paused' state

failureReason.description: Plain-language failure explanation for steps in 'failed' state

sourceAgent.description: Originating agent in case of feedback/revisions (e.g. Critic to Writer)
